app.name: Peak Fitness
app.tagline: A plan that changes with you

onboarding.welcomeTitle: Peak doesn't hand you a plan and walk away
onboarding.welcomeBody: Tell us how you are each day and the session adapts. Each week we look at what actually happened and rebuild it. You get read continuously, not sorted once.
onboarding.basicsBody: These set your calories and your loads. Change them any time.
onboarding.goalBody: Revisited every 6–8 weeks at the phase review.
onboarding.goalRecompBody: Fat down, muscle up — slower and steadier
onboarding.goalGainBody: A measured surplus, not a free-for-all
onboarding.activityTitle: How does your day usually go?
onboarding.daysTitle: How many days can you train?
onboarding.daysBody: Pick a number you will actually hit, not the one you wish for.
onboarding.equipmentBody: Sessions are built from what's available. Nothing at all? There's a bodyweight plan.
onboarding.injuriesBody: We exclude whole movement patterns, then substitute lifts that train the same muscle.
onboarding.allergiesBody: We exclude the allergen and everything derived from it — a sesame allergy removes tahini, hummus and dukkah, not just sesame.
onboarding.generatingBody: You can close the app. We'll notify you when it's ready.
onboarding.blockedBody: Calorie and load programming isn't appropriate under 18. This is a line we don't cross.
onboarding.underweightTitle: A cut isn't the right call right now
onboarding.underweightBody: Your weight is below the healthy range for your height. I can build you a maintenance or gaining plan instead.

consent.title: Before we go on
consent.intro: Your weight, injuries and allergies are sensitive data. We need your explicit permission, and each permission is separate.
consent.processing: Process my health data to build my plan
consent.processingBody: Without this there is no plan to build.
consent.transferBody: We send age, weight, height, sex, goal, injuries and allergies. Never your name, email, phone or user id. Decline and you get rules-based plans with nothing sent at all.

today.title: Today
today.checkInBody: Ten seconds, and today's session adapts to it.
today.restBody: Rest is part of the programme. A walk is plenty.

workout.title: Session
workout.finished: Done. That counts toward your week.

meals.title: Meals
meals.analyzingBody: You can close the app; we'll finish it.
meals.twoTaps: Two taps fix most of the error.
meals.correctBody: If you know the real figure, enter it. Your corrections make your estimates better.
meals.fatNote: The fat range is wider because oil doesn't show in a photo.
meals.photoNeedsServer: Photo analysis needs the server — the model key never ships in the app. Until then, type the meal and answer the two questions.
meals.photoPermission: We need camera access to photograph the meal. The image is analysed and deleted immediately, never stored.
meals.photoNotStored: The photo is not stored. Analysed, then deleted.
meals.labelIntro: Type the values from the pack per 100 g, and how much you ate. This is the most accurate path in the app and it uses no AI at all.
meals.scanning: Point the camera at the barcode
meals.scanFailed: We couldn't find that product. Type the values from the label.
meals.scanInvalid: That barcode didn't read cleanly. Try again.
meals.inconsistent: Those numbers don't add up to the stated calories. Check them — we'll save exactly what you typed.

plan.title: Plan
plan.sourceTemplateBody: Built from our own rules this time. A complete plan, not a reduced one.

review.title: Weekly review
review.intro: Two minutes, and you leave with next week.
review.notYet: The review opens at the end of the week

profile.title: Account
profile.lockBody: Locks the app on this device only.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.whatBody: Age, sex, height, weight, goal, injuries, allergies, your daily check-ins and your meal log.
privacy.whereBody: A Supabase database in the {{region}} region, chosen deliberately and documented here.
privacy.howLongBody: Until you delete your account. The button below really does clear every table.
privacy.modelBody: Age, weight, height, sex, goal, dietary restrictions, allergies, injuries. Nothing else — no name, no email, no phone, no user id.
privacy.photosBody: We don't store them. Analysed, values extracted, deleted immediately. There is no photo bucket at all.
privacy.logsBody: Our logs carry a user id and an event name. No health data in logs, crash reports or analytics.
privacy.deleteBody: Clears your profile, plans, check-ins, meals, corrections and weights. There is no undo.
privacy.deleteDone: All your data has been deleted.
privacy.whereLocal: On this device only, inside your browser. There is no server and nothing leaves the device.
privacy.barcodeBody: Scanning a barcode sends the barcode number, and only that, to a public product database. Nothing about you goes with it — not your account, your weight or your log. You can skip it entirely and type the values from the label.

safety.allergenBlocked: We removed a meal from your plan because it contained {{allergen}}.
safety.substituted: We swapped lifts that aggravate your {{injury}} for ones training the same muscle.
safety.templateFallback: We built this one from our own rules instead of the model. It's a complete plan.

lock.title: Peak is locked
lock.body: Unlock with your fingerprint or device passcode.
lock.unavailable: This device has no fingerprint or passcode enrolled, so the lock is unavailable.

phase.title: Phase review
phase.intro: Every 6–8 weeks we stop and ask one question: same goal, or a different one?
phase.notYet: The phase review opens after 6 weeks

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: We send a six-digit code to your email. No password to remember or lose.
auth.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
auth.failed: That didn't work. Check the code or request a new one.
auth.signOutConfirm: Sign out? Your data stays in your account.
auth.sendFailed: We couldn't send the code. Check your connection and try again.

notify.planReadyBody: Open the app to see your new week.
notify.askTitle: Want us to tell you when it lands?
notify.askBody: One notification when the plan finishes, and nothing else. Turn it off any time in your device settings.
